problem:
Let $R=[-4,0]\times [-5,-2]$ be a region in the $xy$-plane, and let $f(x,y)$ be a function defined over $R.$
The lower and upper Riemann sums corresponding to an arbitrary partition $P$ of $R$ are given by

$$
\begin{aligned}L(f,P) & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}(-2{x}_{i}-5{y}_{j})Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j}, \\ U(f,P) & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}(-2{x}_{i-1}-5{y}_{j-1})Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j}.\end{aligned}
$$

Using the definition of the double integral in terms of $L(f,P)$ and $U(f,P),$ compute ${∬}_{R}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A.$

*Hint: You may wish to make use of the following result:*

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}({x}_{i-1}+{x}_{i})Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j}=({x}_{m}^{2}-{x}_{0}^{2})({y}_{n}-{y}_{0})\end{aligned}
$$
worked_solution:
For a function $f(x,y),$ the double integral of $f$ over a rectangular region $R$ is the unique number $I$ (if it exists) such that

$$
L(f,P)\le I\le U(f,P)
$$

over all partitions $P$ of $R.$

First, notice that ${\overset{¯}{x}}_{i}=\frac{1}{2}({x}_{i-1}+{x}_{i})$ will always lie between ${x}_{i-1}$ and ${x}_{i}$, and similarly ${\overset{¯}{y}}_{j}=\frac{1}{2}({y}_{j-1}+{y}_{j})$ will always lie between ${y}_{j-1}$ and ${y}_{j}.$ Therefore,

$$
-2{x}_{i}-5{y}_{j}\le -2\cdot \frac{1}{2}({x}_{i-1}+{x}_{i})-5\cdot \frac{1}{2}({y}_{j-1}+{y}_{j})\le -2{x}_{i-1}-5{y}_{j-1}
$$

which simplifies to 

$$
-2{x}_{i}-5{y}_{j}\le -({x}_{i-1}+{x}_{i})-\frac{5}{2}({y}_{j-1}+{y}_{j})\le -2{x}_{i-1}-5{y}_{j-1}.
$$

Multiplying this by $Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j}$ and applying the double summation gives:

$$
L(f,P)\le {\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}[-({x}_{i-1}+{x}_{i})-\frac{5}{2}({y}_{j-1}+{y}_{j})]Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j}\le U(f,P)
$$

Separating the sums using the addition and constant multiple rules, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}L(f,P) & \le -{\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}({x}_{i-1}+{x}_{i})Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j}-\frac{5}{2}{\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}({y}_{j-1}+{y}_{j})Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j} \\  & \le U(f,P).\end{aligned}
$$

Using the hint, we get the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}({x}_{i-1}+{x}_{i})Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j} & =({0}^{2}-(-4)^{2})(-2-(-5))=-48 \\ \frac{5}{2}{\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}({y}_{j-1}+{y}_{j})Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j} & =\frac{5}{2}((-2)^{2}-(-5)^{2})(0-(-4))=-210\end{aligned}
$$

Finally then:

$$
\begin{aligned}L(f,P)\le -(-48)-(-210)\le U(f,P)\,⟹\,L(f,P)\le 258\le U(f,P)\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we conclude that 

$$
{∬}_{R}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A=258.
$$
